decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing cascade effects to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The key is to carefully manage resources and timing to execute the combo efficiently and effectively. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for a big finish with a massive creature presence. By cycling through the deck and cascading into the right cards, the player can create a game-winning advantage in a short amount of time.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, Ulamog, and Drowner of Truth. Control elements are included with cards like Ugin, Malevolent Rumble, and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Disciple of Freyalise and Green Sun's Zenith help to accelerate mana production and find key cards. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and disrupt their game plan with control elements, ultimately securing victory through sheer power and strategy.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game by removing threats from the opponent with cards like Wrath of the Skies, Erode, Galvanic Discharge, and Solitude. The deck also includes counterspells like Mana Leak to stop key spells from resolving. Additionally, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin. Price of Freedom can be a powerful finisher, especially if the opponent has been depleted of resources. The deck has a balanced mix of removal, disruption, and win conditions to outlast the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, backed up by instant spells like Mutagenic Growth and Lightning Bolt to deal damage efficiently. Slickshot Show-Off provides additional utility, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and maintaining tempo. With a low mana curve and a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. It prioritizes quick, decisive victories through early pressure and efficient removal spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using Green Sun's Zenith. The key strategy revolves around using Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana, which can then be used to cast big threats like Craterhoof Behemoth or fuel abilities like Grist, the Hunger Tide. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups, while Leyline of Abundance and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional support and value. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful combos and efficient creature plays.

This deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures like Griselbrand or Atraxa onto the battlefield by using instant speed reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude. The deck also includes a variety of support cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negatiob to disrupt opponents and protect key combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Faithful Mending and Otherworldly Gaze help with card selection and filtering to find the necessary pieces to execute the combo. By using these instant reanimation spells efficiently, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and close out games quickly.

The deck revolves around quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. By utilizing cards like Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog to filter through the deck and protect key pieces, the deck aims to reanimate powerful threats like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence. With a mix of control elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while setting up its combo.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and removal spells while utilizing card selection to ensure consistent draws. The deck focuses on maintaining a low mana curve and utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to help dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and creatures with affinity to quickly assemble a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The key strategy revolves around utilizing cards like Urza's Saga, Mox Opal, and Mishra's Bauble to generate mana and card advantage, while also protecting your artifacts with Welding Jar and Claws of Gix. Emry, Lurker of the Loch provides recursion and value, while Engineered Explosives and Sink into Stupor help control the opponent's board. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Sowing Mycospawn and Basking Broodscale to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also incorporates various support cards like Eldrazi creatures, removal spells, and mana ramp to ensure consistency and efficiency in executing the combo. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Urza's Saga provide additional win conditions and disruptive elements to control the game and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk to pressure the opponent while utilizing blink effects such as Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to protect key creatures and re-use valuable enter the battlefield abilities. Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending provide disruption and removal, while Teferi, Time Raveler offers flexibility and control. The deck aims to out-tempo the opponent with its efficient creatures and disruptive spells, while maintaining card advantage through blink effects and card draw from Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Meticulous Archive.

The deck focuses on assembling a wide array of creatures that work together synergistically to generate mana, tutor for specific creatures, and overrun the opponent with a massive amount of power. The key strategy involves using creatures such as Devoted Druid to generate mana, Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for key creatures, and Leyline of Abundance to further accelerate mana production. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in response to different threats, while ultimately aiming to win through a combination of creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Rider combo by using Eldritch Evolution, Neoform, and Summoner's Pact to tutor for the necessary pieces. This combo involves sacrificing Allosaurus Rider to bring out Griselbrand, then drawing through the deck to find and play Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant for a game-winning threat. The deck also features backup plans like Planar Genesis and Ureni, the Song Unending to maintain board presence and provide alternative win conditions. Additionally, the deck includes protection cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful Eldrazi creatures and utilizing the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. Karn, the Great Creator is used to shut down opponent's artifacts, while Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths provide disruption and removal. The deck also includes ways to draw cards and maintain card advantage with Vexing Bauble and Mind Stone. Overall, the strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with large creatures and powerful spells while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting, in order to bring out powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine for aggressive plays. It also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt for direct damage and removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and resilient threats, utilizing the graveyard as a resource for repeated value. The combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells makes it a formidable force in the Modern format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes synergies between cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to quickly build a board presence. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt to control the board and finish off opponents. With the addition of cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Goblin Bombardment, the deck is able to maintain pressure and close out games efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to win through fast and relentless attacks.
